_comment: Subunits Phase 4 reform demo: an 80-man Spearmen regiment staged alone in drill mode (5 files of 16 men, lochos). At tick 60, frontage is narrowed by 1 file (to 4 files of 20) via BracketLeft. Under the subunit reform, the 64 men in the retained files remain in their exact files and ranks without criss-crossing the block, while only the 16 men from the folded flank file march to the rear ranks of the retained files.
